title: Diana Shipping Inc. Announces Direct Continuation of Time Charter Contract for m/v Amphitrite
description: Diana Shipping Inc. has extended the time charter contract for one of its Post-Panamax dry bulk vessels, the m/v Amphitrite, with Cobelfret S.A. for a period until minimum January 1, 2026 up to maximum March 15, 2026. The new charter period is expected to commence on December 31, 2024.
